note: Item codes are bare integers 1-32 that data/nature_relatedness.R invents with row_number() over unique(item) after pivot_longer, so they carry no trace of the source column name; the mapping was rebuilt by re-running that script over the original deposit (core model 3, script-generated integer), reproducing per-item n and mean exactly for 32/32 items. Item and option wording transcribed verbatim from the deposit's codebook.txt: NR-6 Q1-Q6 (codebook: '1=disagree to 5=agree', endpoints only, so resp 2-4 option_text left blank), TIPI1-TIPI10 (1=Disagree strongly..7=Agree strongly), VCL1-VCL16 (1 checked / 0 unchecked). Only deviation from a byte copy: leading tab/space separators and trailing whitespace stripped. The non-words at VCL6 'cuivocal', VCL9 'florted', VCL12 'verdid' kept as written. NR-6 wording cross-checked against Nisbet & Zelenski (2013) text: 6/6 identical. instructions NA: the codebook quotes no whole-instrument instruction; the TIPI stem 'I see myself as:' and the VCL instruction are recorded as section_prompt for sections 2 and 3. correct_response NA: the check-list has no published key. Rights: NR-6 originator article Frontiers in Psychology 4:813 is CC BY 3.0; TIPI originator grants use for any purpose without permission (quote in notes); VCL has no locatable restriction.
public_note: Only items 1-6 of this table are Nature Relatedness Scale (NR-6) items; items 7-16 are the Ten Item Personality Inventory and items 17-32 are a 16-word vocabulary check-list administered in the same session, and the live per-item response ranges (1-5, 1-7 and 0-1) mark the three blocks.
